decisions.q: Rank roles light on the duties you want half a point lower?
decisions.why: Roles built around your core duties got a call 13 of 46 times (28%), roles light on them 0 of 11 (0%).
decisions.answer: Yes. Now in the fit line as "light on wanted duties at a big team minus 0.5".

decisions.q: Send a note to a named person with every application at 8 or more?
decisions.why: With a note: 8 calls from 22 (36%). Without: 8 from 49 (16%).
decisions.answer: Yes. Every CV brief now ends with the note.

decisions.q: Apply cold to companies over 500 people only when the role is built around your core duties?
decisions.why: Under 150 people: 8 calls from 25 (32%). Over 500: 3 from 25 (12%).
decisions.answer: Yes. Roles light on your core duties at 500+ people are now listed for reference only.

decisions.q: Treat 21 days of silence as closed and stop follow ups there?
decisions.why: 22 applications have had no human reply after 21 days.
